hints.title: Maximized Neighboring Distance Placement
hints.text: The best available seat maximizes the minimum distance to any occupied seat, placing candidates at midpoints of adjacent occupied pairs or at room boundaries.

hints.title: Adjacent Seat Interval Evaluation
hints.text: Maintain sorted occupied seat numbers. Evaluate the left boundary seat 0 (distance to first occupied), internal intervals (midpoints between adjacent occupied seats), and right boundary seat n - 1 (distance to last occupied).

hints.title: Seat and Leave Blueprint
hints.text: In seat(): scan adjacent occupied indices, track maximum distance d and candidate seat. Insert chosen seat in sorted order and return it. In leave(p): remove p from occupied list.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Scanning O(N) occupied seats takes linear time per query and maintains compact sorted state.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full array scanning of size 10^9 is impossible; tracking occupied indices is essential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorted list of occupied seats avoids interval tree overhead under modest student count.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling boundary seats 0 and n - 1 distinctly compared to interior midpoint seats.

solutions.approach: JavaScript Binary Search Insertion Midpoint Scanner
